description: Finds hotels by name, destination or brand and returns each one's RoomExpert score, slug and page url. The other tools take that slug, so this is the lookup when the slug is not already known. Can rank by a single axis: "quietest rooms in Tokyo" is destination "tokyo", sort_by_axis "noise". Returns a Markdown table of up to `limit` hotels (name, destination, score, axis score when sorting, loyalty program). An unknown destination returns suggested names; no match says the hotel is not covered.

brand.description: A brand, chain or loyalty program, e.g. "Hyatt", "Autograph Collection".

destination.description: A destination name or slug, e.g. "Kyoto" or "new-york".

query.description: Part of a hotel name, e.g. "park hyatt".

sort_by_axis.description: Rank by this one axis instead of the overall score.

name: search_hotels
title: Search hotels
